cli.usage:
thulu — run AI agents on a governed board

COMMANDS
  init               First-run wizard: configure, start and bootstrap an install
    -root            Where the install lives (default: search upward from the
                     working directory, else ~/.octopus). A directory with no
                     deployment files gets the ones carried in this binary.
    -dry-run         Ask everything, write nothing
    -non-interactive Take every default (for reruns and CI)
  update             Install a published release into this install. Every
                     manifest, image and chart is verified before use, a
                     snapshot is taken first, and a version that does not
                     come up is rolled back on its own
    -version         The release to install (default: the newest allowed)
    -check           Write the change package, change nothing (-o file.md|.json)
    -to              Go back to a version; images only when it is the
                     release's rollback_to, else with -restore <snapshot>
                     (or -restore external for a database you restored)
    -rollback        Go back to the version before this one
    -kept            List the kept versions; -keep/-unkeep pin one
    -ack-manual-steps, -backup-confirmed, -values, -reuse-values,
    -registry, -chart-registry, -api-key-file, -no-fetch-cli, -yes
                       (see thulu update -h)
  apply              Bring the install to the version deploy/.env names
                     (OCTOPUS_VERSION), or -version; same flags as update
  mirror <version>   Copy a release for an air-gapped install: images and
                     their signatures to -to, the chart to -chart-to, and
                     the signed files to -dir
  gc                 List what Thulu left on this Docker host that nothing
                     needs (stopped agents, older images, caches, old backups);
                     never touches non-Thulu objects
    -apply           Remove it (default: only print)
    -unclaimed       Also remove Thulu images nothing configured claims
  uninstall          Remove this install: stack, containers, images, config
    -yes             Do it (default: only print)
    -purge-data      Also delete the database volumes, deploy/.env and backups
  serve              Start the daemon (only the octopus image carries it)
    -addr            Listen address (default :8585)
    -agents-dir      Base directory with agent folders
    -data            Data directory for project worktrees, logs, attachments
  open               Open the dashboard; on a no-login install, with the
                     link that holds its dev token (-root)
  status, ps         List running agents
  logs <agent> [-f]  Show agent logs (-f to follow)
  stop <agent>       Stop a running agent
  agents import <src> Import agents from a directory or a pack.json
                     into a workspace's catalog (-workspace)
  agents verify <dir> Check the database reproduces <dir> exactly
  agents export      Write a workspace's agents as a JSON pack on stdout
  agents gc          Prune history to -keep per file, then collect free blobs
  export             Write a workspace's boards, tasks, projects and config to
                     a tar.gz (-workspace, -out, -data). From a downloaded
                     binary it runs inside the daemon's container
  import <bundle>    Replay a bundle into this install (-workspace, -with-settings,
                     -json, -data). From a downloaded binary it runs inside
                     the daemon's container
  workspace create   Create the first workspace (-name, -slug, -owner-email)
  workspace list     List workspaces: id, name and slug
  keys workspaces    Alias of workspace list
  keys mint          Mint an API key from the host (-workspace, -role, -permissions)
  runner register    Register this machine as a runner (-url, -token)
  runner add-project Map a runner project to its checkout here (<project-id> <dir>)
  runner run         Take and run the agent runs of this machine's projects
  version            Print this binary's version
  help               Show this help

ENVIRONMENT
  OCTOPUS_URL          Daemon address (default http://localhost:8585)
  OCTOPUS_DATABASE_URL Postgres DSN (default: the one deploy/.env names, as this host reaches it)
  OCTOPUS_HOME         Where an install without a checkout lives (default ~/.octopus)
cli.usage_mirror:
usage: thulu mirror <version> [-to REGISTRY] [-chart-to oci://…] [-dir PATH]

Copies one release for an install that cannot reach GitHub or ghcr.io: the
images with their signatures, the chart, and the signed manifest, deploy
bundle and CLI binaries. Nothing is re-signed; the install verifies the
release key's signatures against the copies.
cli.usage_gc:
usage: thulu gc [-apply] [-min-age 1h] [-unclaimed] [-root DIR]

Lists what Thulu left on this Docker host that nothing needs any more and
removes it with -apply. Only Thulu's own objects are ever considered:
containers it labels, images of its own repositories, the cache volumes and
networks of its compose project, and snapshots in <root>/backups beyond the
newest OCTOPUS_BACKUP_KEEP (default 5). Other projects' containers, images,
volumes and networks are never listed or touched. Data volumes are never
removed here; see thulu uninstall -purge-data.
cli.usage_uninstall:
usage: thulu uninstall [-yes] [-purge-data] [-root DIR]

Stops the Thulu stack (docker compose down) and removes every Thulu
container, image (the rollback image included), the agent network and the
install's configuration. Only Thulu's own objects are touched; other
projects on this host are never listed or removed. The volumes holding the
database and worktrees, deploy/.env and the backups stay unless -purge-data
is given. A Kubernetes install only gets the helm/kubectl commands printed.
This binary is not deleted; its path is printed at the end.
cli.serve_not_in_host_build: thulu serve runs in the octopus image; this binary has only the commands for this machine (thulu help)
cli.usage_export_in_daemon:
usage: thulu export [-out FILE] [-workspace ID|SLUG] [-root DIR]

Writes a workspace's boards, tasks, projects and config to a tar.gz. The
export runs inside the daemon's container (docker compose exec, or kubectl
exec in Kubernetes), where the data directory is; only the bundle comes back
to this machine.
cli.usage_import_in_daemon:
usage: thulu import [-workspace ID|SLUG] [-with-settings] [-json] [-root DIR] <bundle.tgz>

Replays a bundle into this install. The import runs inside the daemon's
container (docker compose exec, or kubectl exec in Kubernetes), where the
data directory is; the bundle reaches it on stdin.

flags.root: install root (default: search upward from the working directory)
flags.root_or_home: install root (default: search upward from the working directory, else ~/.octopus)
flags.serve_agents_dir: base directory containing an agents/ subfolder (default: <exe-dir> if it has agents/, else parent of octopus)
flags.serve_data: data directory for project worktrees, logs, attachments (default: <agents-dir>/octopus/data)
flags.agents_templates: mark the imported definitions as clonable templates
flags.agents_gc_keep: revisions to keep per file before collecting blobs
flags.export_workspace: workspace to export, by id or slug (default: the only one)
flags.export_data: data directory holding task-attachments/ and projects/ (or set OCTOPUS_DATA_DIR)
flags.import_data: data directory to write task-attachments/ into (or set OCTOPUS_DATA_DIR)
flags.init_root: repository root (default: search upward from the working directory)
flags.init_dry_run: ask everything, write nothing, run nothing
flags.init_non_interactive: take every default instead of prompting (pairs with a previous run's deploy/.octopus-init.json)
flags.change_registry: pull every image from this mirror, keeping the signed digests (default: OCTOPUS_IMAGE_REGISTRY)
flags.change_chart_registry: the mirror's chart registry, oci://… (default: OCTOPUS_CHART_REGISTRY, else <registry>/charts)
flags.change_api_key_file: file holding the API key that reports the result to the daemon (default: OCTOPUS_API_KEY)
flags.change_operator: who runs this, for the audit log (default: $USER@hostname)
flags.change_ack_manual_steps: confirm the release's manual steps are done
flags.change_backup_confirmed: you hold a backup of your own (required for an external database)
flags.change_no_fetch_cli: do not download the target version's CLI; this binary must be that version
flags.change_delegated: internal: set on the CLI an update started
flags.change_output: with -check: write the change package to this .md or .json file
flags.update_check: write the change package for the target version and change nothing
flags.update_restore: with -to: the snapshot to restore (a file under backups/), or "external"
flags.update_rollback: go back to the version before this one (-to <previous>)
flags.update_branch: removed: a branch installs as a preview build
flags.update_keep: pin a kept version so it is never pruned
flags.update_kept: list the kept versions and how to go back to each
flags.apply_check: write the change package and change nothing
flags.mirror_to: registry to copy the images into (registry.example.com/octopus)
flags.mirror_dir: directory to write the release files and releases.json into
flags.gc_apply: remove what is listed (default: only print it)
flags.gc_min_age: spare stopped agent, sandbox and chat containers that finished less than this long ago
flags.gc_unclaimed: also remove Thulu images no configured or running version claims (agent build bases, MCP servers you turned off)
flags.uninstall_yes: do it (default: only print what would be removed)
flags.uninstall_purge_data: also delete the database and data volumes, deploy/.env and the backups — irreversible
flags.workspace_owner_email: email of the user that owns it (required; created if absent)
flags.keys_workspace: workspace the key belongs to, by id or slug (default: the only one)
flags.keys_permissions: comma-separated permissions, or a preset (read-only, ci, agent, full)
flags.keys_expires_in_days: days until the key expires; 0 = the install's maximum (OCTOPUS_API_KEY_MAX_TTL, 90 days by default)
flags.agents_workspace: Workspace whose catalog to use, by id or slug (default: the only one)
flags.import_workspace: workspace to import into, by id or slug (default: the one the bundle came from, which has to exist here)
flags.import_with_settings: also apply the source install's settings, which reach every workspace of this one
flags.import_json: print the counts as JSON instead of a summary
flags.change_values: Kubernetes: Helm values file for the upgrade (default: deploy/values-<release>.yaml)
flags.change_reuse_values: Kubernetes: keep the values the Helm release was installed with (helm --reuse-values)
flags.runner_url: The daemon address, as this machine reaches it
flags.runner_log: Write the log to this file instead of stderr, rotated at 10 MB with two older copies kept (the service passes runner.log)
flags.init_plain: ask in plain text instead of drawing forms (screen readers, terminals that draw them badly)
flags.init_stack: run this compose file on Docker without asking for the mode or the stack (e.g. deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml to work on Thulu)
